# FatFs R0.15

From https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/arc/ff15.zip (2022-11-06).
License retained in ff.c/ff.h. Local ffconf.h selects code page 437 and no RTC.
FAT12/16/32, one volume, short filenames, no exFAT or formatting.

Imported source line endings and indentation whitespace are normalized;
the upstream license notices are preserved.
